note: Single re-review verdict (latest-word-wins overturn of the 2026-07-17 drop). The 07-17 DROP judged an internal contradiction in the DATA - 'TruMoo Whole Chocolate Milk Half Gallon' with size recorded as 'gallon', halving the per-floz price - not a wrong product class. Measured 2026-07-30 across the live 14-day Walmart union: every capture since 07-23 derives the size from Walmart's own arithmetic (64.364 fl oz / 63.922 fl oz for the half gallon, the separate Gallon item at 126.744 fl oz), the sole bad row lives only in walmart-regular-2026-07-18.json which exits the union on 2026-08-01, and the ranker already prices the cell from the corrected newest rows. TruMoo chocolate milk IS chocolate milk; keeping the drop would suppress a now-correct cell.
